name: padding-content-percent-width-zero-axis-insets
notes: The authored content-box width percentage has zero padding on that same axis, so ordinary outer sizing can resolve it directly against the original containing dimension.
The inner content owner must fill the already-resolved content axis; applying the authored 50% there again incorrectly halves it a second time.
Only opposite-axis point padding is nonzero. With the 96x64 opaque PNG and standard viewports, intended natural-ratio dimensions are integral.
These public sources preserve parent/image/following 8px tail identities. Native evidence against the old frozen candidate is a retained failure, not successful qualification.
